_about: Draft evaluation questions for PF-2, written from the approved guides during PF-1. NOT run against the runtime in PF-1 and NOT part of any metric. Each question names the document and page the answer rests on so PF-2 can review served answers the way I-8 did. Categories: system_access, procedure, grading, blackboard, banner, myuos, turnitin_ithenticate, appraisal, support_contact, troubleshooting, cross_document, unsupported_control.

questions.q: How do I access Blackboard from outside the campus?
questions.expected: website, MyUOS, Login, university e-mail and password, multi-factor authentication by SMS or Microsoft Authenticator

questions.q: Where do I find the Details & Actions panel in a Blackboard course?
questions.expected: course view, manage the course: roster, groups, course image, availability, Collaborate, attendance, announcements

questions.q: How do I add a learning module in Blackboard Ultra?
questions.expected: plus sign, Learning Module or Folder, name it, manage visibility

questions.q: What is the minimum size of a Blackboard course banner image?
questions.expected: at least 1200 x 240 pixels and no larger than 25 KB

questions.q: How do I post grades to students from the Blackboard gradebook?
questions.expected: select Post in the column header of the student grid

questions.q: How do I make Blackboard assign zeros to missing work automatically?
questions.expected: Gradebook Settings, Assign automatic zeros for past due work, then Assign Zeros

questions.q: How do I download the gradebook from Blackboard?
questions.expected: down-arrow icon, Download Gradebook panel, full gradebook or columns, CSV or XLS

questions.q: How do I set accommodations for a student in the gradebook?
questions.expected: three-dot menu at the end of the student row, Accommodations

questions.q: How do I transfer grades from Blackboard to Banner?
questions.expected: Grade Transfer Dashboard, search the course by Course ID and term, View Details, Transfer; Chair and Dean approve

questions.q: Where is the Grade Transfer Dashboard link?
questions.expected: Blackboard Institution Page announcement, or https://op.sharjah.ac.ae/GradeTransfer

questions.q: Who approves the grade transfer to Banner?
questions.expected: the Chair and the Dean, by selecting Transfer in the portal

questions.q: Which grade categories must I set in the Blackboard gradebook?
questions.expected: Coursework, Midterm, Final; the total column must not exceed 100

questions.q: How do I add an attendance column in Blackboard Ultra?
questions.expected: Mark attendance in Details & Actions, Add Attendance, grade schema, grade using, Save

questions.q: How do I share Collaborate attendance with the gradebook?
questions.expected: attendance tab of the session, Share Attendance information with LMS, lateness and absence minutes, required time

questions.q: How do I schedule repeating Collaborate sessions?
questions.expected: View All Sessions, Create Session, start and end date, repeat session option

questions.q: How do I create a graded discussion in Blackboard Ultra?
questions.expected: Discussion Settings, grade the discussion, due date and maximum points; a gradebook column is created

questions.q: How do I require the Respondus LockDown Browser for a test?
questions.expected: Browser Dashboard, Require Respondus LockDown Browser for this exam

questions.q: What question types can I add to a Blackboard assignment?
questions.expected: the question types listed in the guide

questions.q: How do I access iThenticate?
questions.expected: www.ithenticate.com, login, university e-mail and the activation password; servicedesk e-mail if access fails

questions.q: How many documents can I submit to iThenticate per year?
questions.expected: the English page says 30; the Arabic page says 15: an unresolved conflict, the runtime must not serve a single number as settled

questions.q: What is the maximum file size for an iThenticate upload?
questions.expected: less than 100 MB, 400 pages, 2 MB of raw text

questions.q: How do I start the Phase 2 progress review in the HR Portal?
questions.expected: HR Portal, Performance Appraisal, Performance Progress, Start Progress Review or Continue Review

questions.q: What is the maximum size of an evidence file in the performance appraisal?
questions.expected: 10 MB per PDF

questions.q: When is evidence required for an appraisal objective?
questions.expected: when an objective reaches Completed status

questions.q: What can a first line manager do with a submitted progress review?
questions.expected: Return to Employee for Revision (note mandatory) or Approve and Send to HR

questions.q: Why can I not see my approved plan in the Phase 2 review?
questions.expected: Phase 1 not fully approved or the Phase 2 window not open

questions.q: How do I contact the IT Help Desk?
questions.expected: servicedesk e-mail, telephone 06-5050000, extension 2000

questions.q: How do I post an announcement on the MyUOS portal?
questions.expected: portal, + New announcement, title, body, expiry, category, target audiences and e-mail groups, Save for Web Team approval

questions.q: How do I share a Microsoft Forms survey?
questions.expected: Collect Responses: link, QR code, e-mail, Teams or internal website

questions.q: When must final grades be submitted and how do I transfer them to Banner?
questions.expected: within forty-eight hours of the examination to the Department Chair (handbook) and the dashboard transfer steps (guide); two parts, two sources

questions.q: What percentage of absences bars a student from the final exam and how do I record attendance in Blackboard?
questions.expected: 20% (handbook) and the attendance tool steps (guide)

questions.q: How do I reset my Blackboard password?
questions.expected: no guide states a password reset procedure: fallback expected

questions.q: How do I enter grades in Banner Self Service directly?
questions.expected: the guides describe the transfer dashboard, not direct Banner entry: fallback expected

questions.q: What is the Turnitin similarity threshold for a thesis?
questions.expected: not stated in any approved English document: fallback expected
